HOME / MILITARY AIRCRAFT
LONG-RANGE STRIKE

Bomber aircraft.

Aircraft designed primarily to carry and deliver weapons against surface targets, often emphasizing range and payload.

OverviewCommon rolesQuestionsReal-world example
01 / THE AIRCRAFT’S ROLE

Designed around its mission.

Bomber designs balance payload, range, and mission requirements. The category includes very different airframes, so size, speed, and appearance alone do not define it.

RECOGNIZABLE FEATURES

Some have conventional wings and tails; others use a distinctive flying-wing design. A flying wing is not a feature of every bomber.

02 / COMMON ROLES

Where it fits.

  • Long-range missions
  • Surface-strike missions
  • Military exercises

Military aircraft categories can overlap. Equipment and capabilities vary by model, variant, and operator.

03 / A CLOSER LOOK

Good question.

Are all bombers flying wings?

No. Flying-wing aircraft are one design approach. Other bombers use a conventional fuselage and tail.
